<div class="card-body">
'''Blast Door Controls''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ブラスト・ドア（防護扉）操作パネル</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。以下のカードをキャンセルできる。「ガベージ・シュートへ飛び込んで！」「九死に一生」「ドアをふさげ！」「敵を阻め」</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">緊急時に、ブラスト・ドアを閉鎖しロックするためのコントロール・パネル。ルークは、帝国軍を足留めするために、ハンガー・ベイ３２７からパネルを撃った。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blast Door (protective door) control panel.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. May cancel the following cards: [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]; [[Narrow Escape]]; [[Blast The Door, Kid!]]; and [[Rebel Barrier]].

'''Lore:''' A control panel used to close and lock blast doors in an emergency. Luke shot the panel from Hangar Bay 327 to delay the Imperial forces.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card says the named cards can be canceled; the English says it cancels them. The Japanese lore says Luke shot the panel from Hangar Bay 327 to delay the Imperial forces; the English says he destroyed it, locking them out of the bay.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blast Door Controls]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=37s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:37.</ref>
